title: Current Yasui character-twist artifacts show no known Yasui-vs-standard separation
statement: Current artifacts contain nonbaseline character-twist phases, but no current evidence that Yasui Figure 3 a=1/a=3 character-twist functions differ from their standard functions after the correct character-coordinate identification. Standard-side constancy is not currently known to obstruct the exotic-vs-standard goal.
do_not_infer: Do not infer future exotic targets cannot be separated.
Do not infer standard-side baseline behavior is an obstruction.
Do not treat standard/split nonbaseline behavior as a success criterion.
